name: Spicy Starfish 71
author: PriyanshuGupta28
description: Gradient pill blue checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, width becomes calc(50px * .55), height becomes calc(50px * .55), box-shadow becomes inset 0 calc(50px * .07) calc(50px * .1) #ff9d96. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #4158D0 to #4158D0, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px 19px 38px, #000000 0px 15px 12px, width becomes 0.
